summary: Nexentis Technologies Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 410,998 shares of common stock at $7.056 per share, alongside a concurrent private placement of unregistered warrants exercisable at $7.056 per share. The offering price represents a 45.7% discount to the last sale price of $13.00 on June 22, 2026. The transaction is a routine at-the-market or direct shelf takedown under the existing S-3 shelf, not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is mentioned. The offering is expected to close on June 23, 2026. There is no risk-arb angle as this is a standard equity financing, not a transformative event.
